Execute the reporting pipeline using gsm.reporting workflows

Source: R/study_utils.R
execute_reporting_pipeline.Rd

Runs the gsm.reporting workflow layer (workflow/3_reporting) for each snapshot using the mapped data, analytics results, and workflow list from the analytics pipeline output. Returns a named list of reporting results per snapshot.

Usage

execute_reporting_pipeline(analytics_results, config)

Arguments

analytics_results

Output from execute_analytics_pipeline

config

Study configuration object

Value

Named list of reporting results per snapshot
